انتقعن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَقَعْنَ (intaqaʕna) /in.ta.qaʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# اُنْتُقِعْنَ (untuqiʕna) /un.tu.qiʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# اِنْتَقِعْنَ (intaqiʕna) /in.ta.qiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
